motivation: Architecture knowledge is locally formalized but federation-wide ownership, document currentness, dependency invalidation and formalized admission are not first-class or uniformly discoverable.
expected_outcome: Exact federation architecture knowledge becomes machine-derived, source-bound, discoverable, formally invalidated across repositories and required before architecture-changing governed admission.
falsification_conditions: A required peer can remain unknown while federation formalization reports PASS.
A stale document can remain current after its source or dependency changes.
More than one primary semantic owner exists for a required concept.
A VALIDATE_ONLY repository can be treated as an update target.
A fresh repository entrypoint cannot route to the global architecture owner within the declared read bound.
